authority: Dubuque County, Iowa official election archive

sourceDocument.reviewMethod: Human-reviewed visual transcription of the retained scan; page 1 supplies city codes 1-20 and page 2 supplies rural codes 31-45 plus countywide code 46 Absentee.

geometryDisposition.caveat: The archive establishes code-to-polling-place result context. It does not identify a stable GeoPDF path or polygon, and no row-order, equal-count, text-proximity, or color-path inference is adopted.
